lines: Your vault now follows you across machines, so your AI finds the same keys on every Mac.
Esc says where it took you, so you know which view you landed in.
Name your models, so every menu shows the model you'll actually run.
The copilot now brings you ideas, not a list of cards, and speaks up at most three times a day.
The Skills menu opens over the whole window now, so nothing gets cut off in a narrow panel.
Puku threads no longer say "Not logged in" in projects that use Puku's API themselves.
Cloning shows its progress, so you know what's happening before your thread starts.
Fold any column to a strip, and let the fullest ones spread out when you need the room.
Press Z to reopen the last card you had open, so you never lose your place.
Your board now reads like a spreadsheet: every card on one sheet, searchable as you type
Sign in to Weft on first launch, so your profile, Project Sync and share links are ready
The New thread dialog picks the model and the agent together, so a thread starts in your voice
